title.zh: 复盘：只修改一个熟悉的欢迎预设

paragraphs.zh: 沿用邀请里能否带未完成作品的问题，把旧版与只多说明这一点的新版并排，问愿意的伙伴各让哪些参与方式更清楚。可留旧版、改一句或今天不讨论。复盘针对邀请提供的选择，不用总有新问题证明好奇、勇气或人生转变，也不把别人喜欢熟悉做法当缺想象。
paragraphs.en: For whether unfinished work belongs in the invitation, compare the original with a version clarifying only that point. Ask a willing partner which participation choices each makes clear. Keep the original, revise one line or leave discussion for later. Review the invitation without interpreting continual novelty as curiosity, courage or life transformation, or familiar preferences as poor imagination.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果欢迎说明只补一句“也可以带未完成小试验”，它改变了哪些选择，又有哪些旧安排仍可保留？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a welcome added that unfinished experiments were welcome, which choices would change and which familiar arrangements could remain?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷与计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版休闲选项，不测性别、外貌、智力、职业、政治能力、关系需要或诊断；官方人物身份资料不验证题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不猜隐私、不把外貌或身份当笑点，也不评价缺席者。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts. Six names concern this edition’s leisure options, not gender, appearance, intelligence, careers, political ability, relationship needs or diagnosis; official identity sources do not validate the bank. Others may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private life, make no appearance or identity a punchline and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：同桌、分桌和改主意都可自选
title.en: Review shared or separate tables with room to change

paragraphs.zh: 沿用拼贴桌和声音桌，先说当下对哪项内容有兴趣，再约是否、何时想碰面，不默认同伴必须等。看材料后可改选同桌、缩短或结束。可只拟一句邀请。复盘看选择是否合当下兴趣，不靠与众不同证明独立，也不把同桌解释成依赖、把分桌解释成关系问题。
paragraphs.en: For collage and sound tables, state your present interest and ask whether and when to meet, without assuming a companion must wait. Change to the same table, shorten or finish after seeing the materials. Draft an invitation only. Review present interest without interpreting different interests as independence, a shared table as dependence or separate tables as relationship trouble.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友想拼贴而你想试声音桌，怎样表达小偏好、商量再碰面，也保留改主意的空间？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend preferred collage and you wanted the sound table, how would you state the preference, discuss meeting later and leave room to change?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷与计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版休闲选项，不测性别、外貌、智力、职业、政治能力、关系需要或诊断；官方人物身份资料不验证题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不猜隐私、不把外貌或身份当笑点，也不评价缺席者。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts. Six names concern this edition’s leisure options, not gender, appearance, intelligence, careers, political ability, relationship needs or diagnosis; official identity sources do not validate the bank. Others may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private life, make no appearance or identity a punchline and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：可见细节与私人故事分开分享
title.en: Review a visible detail separately from private history

paragraphs.zh: 沿用一片光影的小画，先描述颜色、形状或位置，再决定愿分享哪部分。伙伴可有另一联想，不需证明谁更懂作者；也能完全虚构或不展示。复盘看细节怎样成为创作起点，不用作品推断情绪、共情、父母身份或生活深度，不要求把困难经历做成对别人有用的材料。
paragraphs.en: For the small drawing of light, describe colour, shape or position before choosing what to share. A partner may have another association without claiming to understand its maker better. Invent it entirely or keep it private. Review a creative starting point without interpreting the artwork as evidence of emotion, empathy, parental identity or life depth, or difficult experience as material owed to others.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只想画一片普通光影，怎样让伙伴描述看到什么，而不要求你解释私事或真实情绪？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you wanted only to draw an ordinary patch of light, how would a partner describe what they saw without requesting private history or feelings?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷与计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版休闲选项，不测性别、外貌、智力、职业、政治能力、关系需要或诊断；官方人物身份资料不验证题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不猜隐私、不把外貌或身份当笑点，也不评价缺席者。

Six names concern this edition’s leisure options, not gender, appearance, intelligence, careers, political ability, relationship needs or diagnosis; official identity sources do not validate the bank. Others may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private life, make no appearance or identity a punchline and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：只为需要共用的资源约必要细节
title.en: Review only the details a shared resource needs

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两组共用一个角落，分别问想用哪段时间，再写最小轮流安排和修改办法。可缩小时间表，也能不接协调角色；个人想做什么仍由个人选。可只画两行草表。复盘看约定是否有用，不以大家接受证明公平、权威、政治能力或领导人格，更不把头衔当替人作决定的资格。
paragraphs.en: For two groups sharing a corner, ask which time each wants and draft a minimal rotation with a way to revise it. Simplify or decline coordination while individual activity choices remain individual. Sketch two rows only. Review usefulness without interpreting acceptance as evidence of fairness, authority, political ability or leadership personality, or a title as permission to decide for others.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果两组都想用同一个角落，怎样只约必要的时间与修改办法，而不把所有个人选择都变成规则？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If two groups wanted one corner, how would you agree necessary time and revision details without regulating every personal choice?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷与计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版休闲选项，不测性别、外貌、智力、职业、政治能力、关系需要或诊断；官方人物身份资料不验证题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不猜隐私、不把外貌或身份当笑点，也不评价缺席者。

Six names concern this edition’s leisure options, not gender, appearance, intelligence, careers, political ability, relationship needs or diagnosis; official identity sources do not validate the bank. Others may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private life, make no appearance or identity a punchline and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：先问作者，再试能拆回的材料组合
title.en: Review a reversible combination with its maker’s agreement

paragraphs.zh: 沿用裂开的装饰与闲纸形，先问作者是否愿意试新用途，再把组合版和原版并排。可拆开、修回、搁置或都不用，不需把破损说成美的义务。可只画草图。复盘只谈材料与制作乐趣，不以意外用途评天才、神经差异、创伤或社交身份，也不要求保留不想要的东西。
paragraphs.en: For the torn decoration and spare shape, ask the maker before trying a new use and compare it with the original. Separate, repair, set aside or use neither without a duty to find damage beautiful. Sketch only if preferred. Review materials and enjoyment without interpreting reuse as evidence of genius, neurodivergence, trauma or social identity, or an obligation to keep unwanted things.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果装饰裂出新轮廓，怎样先征求作者想法，再提供组合、修回或不用的选择？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a decoration tore into a new outline, how would you ask its maker before offering combination, repair or no use?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答卷与计数的公开说明。六名称只对应本版休闲选项，不测性别、外貌、智力、职业、政治能力、关系需要或诊断；官方人物身份资料不验证题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不猜隐私、不把外貌或身份当笑点，也不评价缺席者。

title.zh: 复盘：欢迎小贡献，也说清可用位置与时间
title.en: Review a small welcome with actual space and time

paragraphs.zh: 沿用主题外的小作品，先核真正可用的位置、时间和展示方式，再由作者决定合不合适。可以只放一下就走，也能拒绝，不承诺全场喜欢或要求讲身世。可只改邀请卡。复盘看信息是否清楚、双方是否仍有自己的活动，不以接纳多少人证明善良、归属或固定辅助角色。
paragraphs.en: For the off-theme piece, check actual space, time and display format before its maker decides whether it fits. They may show it briefly, leave or decline, without promised approval or a personal history. Revise an invitation card only. Review clarity and room for both people’s activities without interpreting the number of people welcomed as evidence of goodness, belonging or a fixed supporting identity.

title.zh: 借自愿艺术下午聊不同选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary art afternoon

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果作者只想展示一件偏题小作品就离开，怎样说清可用位置和时间，又不要求更长参与或个人解释？”各拟一种做法，再从另一角色角度改一处。可只用虚构例子，不需参加活动、购物、展示作品或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a maker wanted to show a small off-theme piece and leave, how would you state available space and time without requiring more participation or a personal explanation?” Suggest an approach each and revise through another character angle. Use invented examples without attending, shopping, displaying work or sharing personal experiences.
